metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2004 · Fahrenheit 9/11
metas.description: Michael Moore's view on what happened to the United States after 9/11 and how the Bush Administration allegedly used the tragic event to push forward its agenda for unjust wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2004 · Super Size Me
metas.description: While examining the influence of the fast food industry, Morgan Spurlock personally explores the consequences on his health of a diet of solely McDonald's food for one month.
